select * from (select t.finprod_id finprodId,t.share_amt shareAmt,t.yield,t.ps,t.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, pt.PORTFOLIO_ID,t.UPDATE_TIME from trd_product_deal t inner JOIN trd_product_deal_add tpda on t.TRADE_ID=tpda.TRADE_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON t.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN fin_product_type fpt on t.finprod_id=fpt.finprod_id and t.branch=fpt.branch inner join ptl_trade pt on pt.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID where 1=1
AND pt.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
and #{sysDate} =t.SETTLE_DATE and T3.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F10}) and t.trade_status='01' and t.is_cancel='N' and t.ps in(#{PS_T01},#{PS_T02},#{PS_T05},#{PS_T19},#{PS_T46},#{PS_T47},#{PS_T48})
union all select t.finprod_id finprodId,t.share_amt shareAmt,t.yield,t.ps,t.UNIT_CPRICE unitCprice, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID,t.UPDATE_TIME from trd_product_temp_deal t inner JOIN trd_product_temp_deal_add tpda on t.TRADE_ID=tpda.TRADE_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON t.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN fin_product_type fpt on t.finprod_id=fpt.finprod_id and t.branch=fpt.branch where 1=1 and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ptl_sec_position_flow pspf where pspf.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID )
AND tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
and #{sysDate} =t.SETTLE_DATE and T3.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F10}) and t.trade_status='01' and t.is_cancel='N' and t.ps in(#{PS_T01},#{PS_T02},#{PS_T05},#{PS_T19},#{PS_T46},#{PS_T47},#{PS_T48}) ) a order by a.UPDATE_TIME asc
